name: Jumping ability (abstracted; not the RYR2 gene)
summary: A stand-in for inherited jumping ability: each J copy adds jump strength. Its alleles are invented. The id is historical. The real RYR2 gene is the calcium-release channel of heart muscle, and no variant of it is established to affect jumping, performance or any other trait in the horse; research on equine heart-rhythm genetics has not produced a validated RYR2 allele.

phenotypes.name: Jumper
phenotypes.description: Two jumping copies. The strongest jump this locus gives.

phenotypes.name: Part jumper
phenotypes.description: One jumping copy, half the effect.

phenotypes.name: Wild type
phenotypes.description: No jumping copy. Ordinary jump strength.
